root_idea.summary: A semantic field opposed to narrowness and difficulty: breadth, spaciousness, sufficiency, capacity, and abundance.
root_idea.development: The root develops from physical or spatial breadth to ample circumstances and means, ability or capacity, and the encompassing of things through knowledge, power, mercy, or provision.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Distinct Quranic Form IV active participle.

senses.definition: To encompass, contain, or extend over completely; to embrace something within the scope of knowledge, mercy, power, or another domain.
senses.usage_conditions: Used with an object or domain that is fully encompassed; Quranic constructions include encompassing all things in knowledge or mercy and extending over the heavens and the earth.

senses.definition: One possessing ample means; financially able or wealthy.
senses.usage_conditions: In the construction عَلَى الْمُوسِعِ قَدَرُهُ, it denotes the person whose means permit the specified provision.

senses.definition: Making something ample or expansive; providing or extending abundantly.
senses.usage_conditions: In the plural predicate of 51:47, it describes an expansive or abundantly providing activity rather than merely possession of wealth.

senses.definition: Abundance, ample means, or a prosperous and unstraitened condition.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quran it chiefly denotes breadth of means or circumstances, especially the financial capacity relevant to provision and support.

senses.definition: Vast, all-encompassing, or ample in scope and capacity; abundant in power, knowledge, mercy, bounty, or related divine attributes.
senses.usage_conditions: A predicative active participle whose particular domain of vastness is supplied by context, including encompassing scope, ability, favor, provision, mercy, or forgiveness.
Used of a place such as the earth and, in an abstract construction, of a domain such as mercy; the feminine form agrees with the noun it describes.

senses.definition: Capacity, ability, or the extent of what one can bear or undertake.
senses.usage_conditions: Used in the construction بِوُسْعِهِ or وُسْعَهَا, ‘according to its capacity’; particularly the capacity within which a person or thing is charged or acts.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be sufficient in capacity for a thing; of a vessel or place, to hold it or a company.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with the thing contained or with the people accommodated.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be within someone’s power, proper for them, or allowable for them to do.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Especially in the construction لَا يَسَعُكَ أَنْ تَفْعَلَ كَذَا, ‘it is not within your power or proper for you to do such a thing.’

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make someone’s means of subsistence ample.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with عَلَى, especially of making a person’s livelihood abundant.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make wide, spacious, roomy, or ample; to make room for someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Includes making room for someone in a sitting or standing place and making room mutually among people.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To amplify, enlarge, or make plentiful someone’s means of subsistence.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A causative construction contrasted with making livelihood narrow or restricted.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make a thing, affair, or condition ample or sufficient for someone; to free it from straitness.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: May take a thing, an affair, or an abstract object such as mercy as what is made sufficient for the recipient.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make room or ample space for someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of making room for a person in a place of standing or sitting.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To enrich someone or render them free from want.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A causative result involving removal of poverty or need.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become ample or abundant in one’s circumstances or means of subsistence.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used particularly of becoming comfortable or plentifully provided in one’s life.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To take a wide range or to expatiate in an affair or place.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The range may be taken in a matter, in a dwelling or space, or in another field of activity.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be profuse or expansive in bounty and munificence.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative use describing breadth or profusion in generosity.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To expand, spread out, dilate, or widen.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Intransitive use describing something becoming more extended or spacious.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To extend a word’s signification by using it in a wider range.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical usage concerning broadened application of an expression.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To stride in walking.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A bodily manner of walking associated with taking an expansive step.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For a state, condition, or life to become free from straitness, ample, or plentiful.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of circumstances and means of life becoming unstraitened.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To widen, expand, dilate, or become distended.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Includes ordinary widening and the specific use of a belly becoming wide or distended.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be capable of doing a thing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with لِـ to express capacity for undertaking an affair.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The interior or inner capacity of a well.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized nominal use in the expression اِتِّسَاعُ البِئْرِ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Extension of the signification of a word or phrase; amplification of its range.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical usage concerning semantic extension.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Width, breadth, extent, or space from side to side.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A spatial noun describing the amount of room or lateral extent.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Ample scope for action; competence, capacity, power, or ability.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of the room or ability available for undertaking an action, beyond mere physical width.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Breadth of character or liberality of disposition.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The expression سَعَةُ الصَّدْرِ denotes breadth of character or temper.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Allowability in ordinary circumstances, apart from poetic necessity.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional usage in the expression فِي السَّعَةِ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A horse wide in step, or a swift and generous horse.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized description of a horse’s stride or quality.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Having ample means or ample power and ability; powerful.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of abundant livelihood or of extensive ability in a person or thing.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Large or liberal in disposition.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative use in descriptions of a broad or generous character.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Wide-stepping in running, especially of a horse.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized description of breadth of stride.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Wider or widest.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The comparative or superlative form of spatial or figurative breadth.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Amply or abundantly provided with the means of subsistence.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A passive participial description of someone whose livelihood has been made ample.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Width, extent, or ampleness of space or quantity; a place of spaciousness.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A noun denoting an available expanse or spacious place.
